metadata.description: Skills for writing browser tests with Biloba in Go/Gomega or TypeScript/Vitest suites.

plugins.name: biloba-go
plugins.description: Write fast, stable Biloba tests in Go/Ginkgo/Gomega: setup, polling and matcher idioms, locators, realistic input, visual assertions, API lookup, diagnostics, flake prevention, and flake hunts.

plugins.name: biloba-vitest
plugins.description: Write fast, stable Biloba tests in TypeScript/Vitest: daemon and shared-Chrome setup, sessions and locators, polling assertions, realistic input, visual assertions, diagnostics, flake prevention, and flake hunts.
